rationale: The primary short thesis remains intact as GLOB continues to trade in the bottom third of its daily range (30.4%) and well below session VWAP ($41.15). Although price has drifted slightly above the 5-minute 9-EMA ($40.74) to $40.88 on very light 1-minute volume, the move is less than half of a 5-minute ATR ($0.31) against entry and well clear of the $41.25 invalidation level. With the bid-ask spread currently wide at 51.4 bps ($40.81 x $41.02), exiting prematurely incurs unnecessary friction while the broader intraday downtrend below VWAP is still valid.
